proposed_rules.trigger: FAQ answer [region] nodes whose y-position falls after/overlapping the footer or other unrelated sections, caused by the capture tool promoting absolutely-positioned collapsed-accordion panels out of their DOM parent.
proposed_rules.decision: Reassign each stray [region] node to the answer cell of its matching question row inside the FAQ accordion block; do not treat as separate footer-area content.
proposed_rules.rationale: The regions' text ('Standard support helps you build...', 'Book a call with our team...') clearly answers earlier FAQ questions despite rendering below the footer/cookie overlay, confirming a positioning artifact rather than real page content in that location.

proposed_rules.trigger: A 'How Does it Work?' heading followed by a component describing a sequential sign-up/onboarding flow (e.g. 'Sign your Knack Health plan...').
proposed_rules.decision: Model the steps component as a dedicated 'process-steps' block (one row per step) rather than plain default-content paragraphs, so the step sequence can be reused across other Knack Health vertical pages. Rejected alternative: leaving it as flowing default-content text.
proposed_rules.rationale: The 'how does it work' + step-sequence pattern is a recognizable component likely reused on sibling health-vertical landing pages, warranting a structured block rather than prose.
